title: Chronic Pain After Groin Hernia Surgery in Women
brief_summary: The goal of this study was to evaluate chronic pain and reoperation rates due to recurrence after groin hernia surgery in women compared to men and surgical method.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients 15 years and older included in the SHR between 1 Sept. 2012 and 31 Aug 2017. Both elective and acute surgery is included.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients not responding to questionnaire. Patients were the first operation during inclusion period was a reoperation.
* Patient with bilateral operations during the study-period are only included once.
study_population: All patients 15 years and older included in the SHR between 1 Sept. 2012 and 31 Aug 2017.
